words.definition: able to do something well, being talented
words.example: He is adept at calming noisy children.
words.zh: 能夠把某事做好，有才華

words.definition: to stick to or follow precisely
words.example: All laboratory visitors must adhere to the safety rules posted beside the entrance.
The industrial revolution fostered the rise of the middle class.
Heavy snow forced the city to halt bus service until the roads were safe.
They handled themselves very well given the circumstances.

words.definition: to give protection; to not express a desire or opinion, usually bad
words.example: He harbors ill feelings for her.
words.zh: 給予保護；不表達願望或意見，通常是不好的

words.definition: something that causes pain or damage
words.example: Excessive radiation is harmful to the body.
words.zh: 引起疼痛或傷害的東西

words.example: The amount of rainfall this summer has been insignificant.

words.definition: not easily understood or figured out
words.example: He had a mysterious effect on everyone who heard him speak.
It is perilous to exceed the speed limit.
words.zh: 具有威脅性或危險性；有害

words.definition: to encourage or advertise; to elevate in rank or grade
words.example: Many nations promote tourism to lure foreign currency.
words.zh: 鼓勵或做廣告；提升軍階或等級

words.example: The final paragraph was redundant because it repeated the same idea without adding evidence.
words.zh: 過度；表現出不必要的重複

words.example: The insurance company rejected the claim.
The discovery of a vaccine for smallpox was a substantial medical achievement.
words.zh: 重要的;製作精良；有價值的

words.definition: specific qualities that distinguish one from another
words.example: Her sense of humor and cheerful personality are some of her most impressive traits.
words.zh: 區分一個人與另一個人的特定特質

words.example: The rapid rise in sea level underscores the need for stronger coastal protection.
